question: C, D, E, G, H, I and J are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between E and G when counted from the left of G. C sits third to the left of J. D sits to the immediate right of J. D sits second to the left of E. I is not an immediate neighbor of C. Who sits third to the right of H?
solution:
**Given:** C, D, E, G, H, I and J are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. C sits third to the left of J. 

2. D sits to the immediate right of J.

3. D sits second to the left of E. 

4. I is not an immediate neighbor of C.

5. Only two people sit between E and G when counted from the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/268b28ca94f8b3ffac0daa466b2dd118ac52645bd7acce76201ee5001fac0bbc.png] 

Thus, I sits between D and E.

H, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a086fbd3bd57defbdae15f746fb1b59c208b852b0ea6a0cdc572aaccddab30ea.png] 

Thus, D sits third to the right of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
